info.name: AI Powered Web App API
info.description: AI-powered chatbot with conversation history using LangGraph and MongoDB

request.description: Root endpoint with API information
Health check endpoint

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Generate and send OTP to user's email. Creates a 6-digit OTP, stores it in the database with 5-minute expiration.
Register a new user account. Verifies the OTP, creates a new user with 'student' role, sends welcome email, and returns access and refresh tokens.
Register a new admin account. Verifies the OTP, creates a new user with 'admin' role, sends welcome email, and returns access and refresh tokens.
Authenticate user and return access tokens. Validates credentials, sends login notification email, and returns JWT tokens.
Authenticate admin and return access tokens. Validates credentials, checks for admin role, sends login notification email, and returns JWT tokens.
Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.
Request a password reset by sending an OTP to the user's email. Generates an OTP and emails it to the user if the account exists.
Verify OTP and reset the user's password. Validates the OTP, updates the user's password, and sends confirmation email.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for signup, login, and password reset

item.name: Chatbot

request.description: Send a message to start a new chat. Creates a new chat session and returns the assistant's response with a new chat_id.
Continue an existing chat conversation by providing the chat_id. Maintains conversation history.
Send a message using a specific LLM model. Allows choosing between available models like gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview, etc.
Get list of all available LLM models. Returns models grouped by provider, based on configured API keys.
Retrieve all chat sessions for the authenticated user. Returns chat metadata sorted by most recently updated.
Retrieve a specific chat session with full message history. Fetches chat metadata and all messages with timestamps and usage data.
Delete a specific chat session and all associated messages. Removes chat metadata and all messages from MongoDB.

item.description: Chatbot endpoints for sending messages, managing chats, and viewing available models

item.name: User Management

request.description: Get the current logged-in user's profile details.
Update the current user's name. Sends confirmation email after update.
Update the current user's password. Password is automatically hashed and confirmation email is sent.
Update both name and password simultaneously.
Delete the authenticated user's account permanently. Removes user from database and sends confirmation email.
Get the current logged-in admin's profile details.
Update the current admin's profile (name or password).
Delete the authenticated admin's account permanently.
Get a list of all users (Admin only). Returns all users without password hashes.
Create a new user with student role (Admin only).
Create a new user with admin role (Admin only).
Delete a user by email (Admin only).
